summary: Feed s183_triple to IDS is degraded: 3 faults detected. VLAN tags 10,20 are completely stripped (100% untagged), 8.6% of frames are sliced to ~192 bytes breaking full-payload inspection, and 74.8% encrypted traffic exceeds IDS 60% tolerance.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags or forwarding untagged SPAN; required VLANs 10 and 20 never appear (100% untagged) so VLAN-aware policies cannot be enforced.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot segment or correlate detections by VLAN 10/20, misses lateral movement and segmentation violations, and VLAN-based detection rules never fire.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q tags at broker egress so IDS receives VLAN 10,20 as required for its detection logic

findings.root_cause: Packet broker slicing/snaplen set to ~192 bytes; 153/1779 frames (8.6%) are cut short, exceeding 5% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection; sliced packets hide application payload, causing missed exploits and broken stream reassembly.

recommended_fix.why: Disable slicing or increase snaplen to 1518+ to deliver full payload this IDS requires

findings.root_cause: 74.8% of bytes are encrypted vs 60% IDS tolerance; traffic is forwarded without selective decryption or filtering, blinding payload inspection.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot inspect encrypted payloads, reducing detection coverage to metadata only and increasing false negatives for encrypted C2/exfiltration.

recommended_fix.why: Add selective TLS decryption or filter/route encrypted flows to a decryption zone; otherwise IDS will remain blind above its 60% encrypted tolerance
